errors.text_span: започва от стойност 7,8% през 2017 г., увеличава се до 7,3% през 2018 г., след това до 6,8% през 2019 г., 4,4% през 2020 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the percentage values to their corresponding years. The first percentage value, 7.8%, corresponds to the year 2018, not 2017. Subsequently, 7.3% is for 2019 (not 2018), 6.8% is for 2020 (not 2019), and 4.4% is for 2021 (not 2020). The description also omits the data for 2021 from the sequence.
The description claims the value 'increases to 7.3%', but the trend shown in the chart is a decrease from 7.8% (in 2018) to 7.3% (in 2019).
The description states that the orange line has a dotted ('пунктиран') style, but the line is solid in the figure.

The description fails to explain what the orange line and its associated percentage values represent (i.e., the annual growth rate of internet buyers). It only lists some of the values without context.
